you_should_know.title: San Antonio City Council approves renaming Cesar E. Chavez Boulevard back to Durango Boulevard
you_should_know.summary: San Antonio's City Council voted to rename Cesar E. Chavez Boulevard back to Durango Boulevard, following a March "New York Times" report that brought multiple sexual misconduct allegations against Chavez to the forefront. The change lands on 295 addresses, among them Southtown Joe's, a coffee shop in Southtown, the neighborhood just south of downtown San Antonio, where an old Durango street sign is already displayed inside; residents and business owners there greeted the old name's return as their own neighborhood coming back.
